<!doctype html><html lang="it"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><meta name="theme-color" content="#070914"><meta name="description" content="ZetaWallet — Privacy Policy"><title>Privacy Policy | ZetaWallet</title><style>
:root{--bg:#070914;--panel:#0d1122;--text:#f5f7ff;--muted:#aeb6d1;--a:#43bfff;--b:#5145ff;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%,#18358a55,transparent 32%),radial-gradient(circle at 90% 10%,#4327a044,transparent 30%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.7}
.wrap{max-width:980px;margin:auto;padding:24px 16px 60px}.hero,.card{background:rgba(13,17,34,.94);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0005}.hero{text-align:center;border-radius:28px;padding:38px 22px;margin-bottom:18px}.logo{width:108px;height:108px;border-radius:24px;display:block;margin:auto auto 18px;box-shadow:0 15px 45px #3567ff55}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,46px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 8px}.sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0}.meta{font-size:13px;color:#8993b2}.switch{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:18px}.switch button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#11172b;color:#cbd2eb;padding:9px 17px;border-radius:99px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.switch button.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--b),var(--a));color:#fff;border:0}.card{border-radius:20px;padding:27px 30px;margin:15px 0}.card h2{font-size:23px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 10px}.card p,.card li{color:#dce1f2}.card li{margin:6px 0}.notice{border-left:3px solid var(--a);background:#43bfff0d;padding:14px 17px;border-radius:10px}.placeholder{color:#7fd6ff}.lang{display:none}.lang.on{display:block}footer{text-align:center;color:#7f89a8;font-size:13px;padding-top:25px}@media(max-width:600px){.hero{padding:28px 16px;border-radius:22px}.card{padding:21px 18px}.logo{width:88px;height:88px}}
@media print{body{background:#fff;color:#111}.hero,.card{box-shadow:none;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd}.card p,.card li{color:#222}.switch{display:none}.lang{display:block!important}}
</style></head><body><main class="wrap">
<header class="hero"><img class="logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
<div class="card">
<h2>1. Titolare del trattamento</h2>
<p>ZetaWallet è un'applicazione wallet di criptovalute non-custodial.<br>Il titolare del trattamento è:<br><strong>Manuel Centrone</strong><br>Italia<br>Email: mysecretchatassistenza@gmail.com</p>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h2>10. Diritti dell’utente</h2>
<p>Quando il GDPR è applicabile, l’utente può avere diritti di accesso, rettifica, cancellazione, limitazione, opposizione, portabilità e altri diritti previsti dalla legge.<br>Richieste: mysecretchatassistenza@gmail.com</p>
</div>
<div class="card">
<h2>14. Contatti</h2>
<p>Per domande sulla privacy: mysecretchatassistenza@gmail.com</p>
</div>
<footer>
<p>© 2026 ZetaWallet</p>
</footer>
</main>
</body>
</html>
